message.content:
**Miraculous Ladybug Season 2, Episode 12** was released on **March 30, 2018** in its original U.S./IMDb listing as **“Gorizilla”**[5]. Some episode guides for the international order list Season 2, Episode 12 as **“Captain Hardrock”** with an April 10, 2018 release in Switzerland[4], so the exact date depends on which broadcast order you mean.

If you meant the episode numbering used on the official season page, Season 2 episode 12 is listed as **“The Sapotis”** on the show’s season page[3].
